title: UK labour market overview — earnings, unemployment and vacancies (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET), the last labour read before the 2027-04-29 April Monetary Policy Report round
source: EST: gov.uk/government/statistics/announcements/uk-labour-market-april-2027, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the statutory pre-announcement register reads 'Release date: 20 April 2027 7:00am (confirmed)', producer Office for National Statistics, 'Published: 30 June 2026', 'Last updated: 30 June 2026', with no amendment note (unlike the 2027-02-16 entry, whose own register line records 'Reason for change: Input error corrected'). Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics — the same gap all six 2026-27 siblings were filed under. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-labour-market-2027-02-16, 2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-labour-market-2027-02-16 LANE, 2026-09-10. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: it is the only unfiled release left in the run this chain has otherwise diarised end to end — 2026-09-15, 10-20, 11-17, 12-15, 2027-01-19 and 2027-02-16 are canonical, 2027-03-16 exists as a proposal from the uk-labour-market-2027-01-19 lane, and 2027-05-18 is proposed alongside this file — so filing it closes the gap rather than refining an entry. It is also the one placement claim in that run that this calendar can already check against a CANONICAL counterparty: boe-decision-2027-04-29 is already tracked (medium) and the Bank's own upcoming-MPC-dates page, fetched today, describes it as 'April MPC Summary and minutes and April Monetary Policy Report'. This release lands D-9 before it, and the next labour print (2027-05-18, proposed alongside) lands D+19 after it — so this is unambiguously the last labour read before the Bank's second forecast round of 2027, established by register rather than by argued precedent. WHAT IT CARRIES, by the window rule this chain has reconfirmed five times firsthand: DEC 2026-FEB 2027 average weekly earnings and Labour Force Survey estimates, JAN-MAR 2027 vacancies, MARCH 2027 payroll flash. NOTE WHAT IT IS NOT, because the proposing lane's headline finding turns on the distinction: Dec-Feb is NOT a calendar quarter, so an MPR quarterly private-AWE diamond does not map onto this window 1:1 — only the February, May, August and November releases are quarter-aligned. This release is therefore the pre-round INPUT shape (five of the six siblings' shape) rather than the post-round SETTLEMENT shape the proposing print has, and a lane researching it should not inherit the settlement framing. TIERED LOW on the same argued grounds as every sibling: symbols [], this repo tracks no UK-listed symbol, no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed, and the measured cable reaction to the 2026-08-18 release was ~0.1% on a two-sided beat. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
